name: Las Colinas Village
summary: Las Colinas Village is a community shopping center located in the prestigious Las Colinas area of Irving, Texas, managed by Whitestone REIT. Serving the surrounding business district and residential neighborhoods, this open-air property offers convenient access to retail and dining options with extended hours and has earned strong community ratings.
demographics: Las Colinas Village serves the affluent Las Colinas area of Irving, attracting middle to upper-income professionals and families with household incomes typically exceeding $75,000. The trade area draws from the nearby Las Colinas business district, bringing in white-collar workers aged 25-54 seeking convenient shopping and dining options near their offices. The center caters to time-pressed professionals and established families who value quality retailers and services in an accessible, open-air format within the master-planned Las Colinas community.
description: Las Colinas Village is a community shopping center strategically located on John W. Carpenter Freeway in the prestigious Las Colinas area of Irving, Texas. Managed by Whitestone REIT, a Houston-based real estate investment trust specializing in community-centered retail properties, this open-air center serves as a convenient retail destination for the surrounding business district and residential neighborhoods. The property benefits from its prime location within Las Colinas, one of the Dallas-Fort Worth metroplex's most desirable master-planned communities known for its corporate headquarters and upscale living. With extended operating hours from 5:30 AM to 10:00 PM, Las Colinas Village accommodates the busy schedules of local professionals and residents seeking quality shopping, dining, and services. The center has earned strong community recognition with a 4.6-star rating from nearly 500 reviews, reflecting its role as a valued neighborhood retail hub in this dynamic North Texas market.
